page_title: REN 1-1 STR | Rennes v Strasbourg 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' The ball goes out for a corner. Rennes can continue in their attacking effort.
90+5' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+4' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt only went low to the middle of the goal, so Matz Sels stops it easily.

87' Martin Terrier (Rennes) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
86' The total number of attempts is 17:10.
86' Here is a change. Thomas Delaine is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Eduard Sobol (Strasbourg).
86' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
83' The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner.
82' Substitution. Ludovic Blas leaves the pitch and is replaced by Fabian Rieder (Rennes).
82' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) replaces Amine Gouiri.
81' 1 - 1 Goal! Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
78' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Strasbourg.
76' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) replacing Emanuel Emegha.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Junior Mwanga as he is replaced by Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nemanja Matic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes).
73' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Strasbourg was in an offside position.
72' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Florent Batta has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
70' Bruno Genesio prepares a substitution. Lorenz Assignon is replaced by Guela Doue (Rennes).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Martin Terrier (Rennes) comes onto the pitch for Arnaud Kalimuendo.

70' What a sensational goal that would have been! Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) picks up the ball inside the box and fires a beautiful first-time shot, but it goes just a few inches wide of the left post.
69' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) sends an accurate short pass. Arnaud Kalimuendo controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
68' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) brings an opponent down and Florent Batta interrupts the game.
64' Rennes take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
64' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
63' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
61' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florent Batta had an easy-decision to make.
61' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.
60' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
60' A free kick is awarded to Rennes.
58' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Moise Sahi Dion will be replaced by Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg).
58' Here's the change. Angelo leaves the pitch and Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.
58' 11:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
57' A quickly taken corner by Rennes.
57' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' The free kick will be taken by Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes).
54' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
53' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florent Batta blows for a foul.
51' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
51' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him.
50' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
50' A player from Strasbourg brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
50' Jeanuel Belocian (Rennes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
49' The game is interrupted now, Jeanuel Belocian (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
47' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
46' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.
46' Angelo finds some space and receives a very precise long pass from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg).
46' Florent Batta blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nemanja Matic (Rennes) was quite harsh and Florent Batta didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Angelo (Strasbourg) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area. The opposition's defence outnumbers the attacking players inside the box and they manage to make a clearance.
43' Florent Batta interrupts the game. One of the players from Rennes won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Strasbourg.
41' One of the players from Rennes times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
40' Wow, what an escape. Amine Gouiri (Rennes) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
39' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:5.
37' Angelo (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' The ball is cleared after Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
33' Strasbourg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
33' A cross into the box from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is cleared.
32' Strasbourg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
27' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
27' The Rennes players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
23' That's a clear yellow card. Matz Sels (Strasbourg) goes into the book.

23' 1 - 0 Goal! Adrien Truffert (Rennes) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Matz Sels is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:0.
22' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) finds Ludovic Blas with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
20' Chance! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Lorenz Assignon, but his shot from inside the box flashes just over the bar.
18' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) trips an opposition player and Florent Batta signals a foul.
16' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
14' The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
12' Gerzino Nyamsi (Strasbourg) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
11' Desire Doue (Rennes) jumps into a tackle and Florent Batta signals a foul.

9' What a save from Steve Mandanda! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
8' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
7' What a big chance! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
5' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.
5' Florent Batta shows a yellow card to Gerzino Nyamsi (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
5' Angelo (Strasbourg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
3' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Ludovic Blas (Rennes), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
2' Angelo (Strasbourg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Steve Mandanda intercepts the ball.
2' Strasbourg have a free kick.
